hero.headline: Start free.
hero.body: Choose capacity for the number of AI workers you need. The same authority and oversight model applies at every size.

plans.headline: Capacity at a glance.
plans.body: Monthly prices in US dollars. Paid plans can't be bought yet.

plans.name: Free
plans.audience: Start with a small supervised workforce.

plans.name: Team
plans.audience: Coordinate a growing workforce across a team.

plans.name: Business
plans.audience: Run more workers across recurring company work.

plans.name: Scale
plans.audience: Plan for a larger governed workforce.

notice.title: Paid plans aren't open yet
notice.body: New organizations start on Free. Team, Business and Scale describe the product catalog; checkout is not connected yet, so they are not a live offer.

items.title: Capability and policy checks
items.body: Every external action is checked, on every plan.

items.title: Human approval
items.body: Actions wait for a person whenever the rule requires it.

items.title: Connected tools, inspectable results
items.body: Work runs through the same gateway and leaves the same record.

items.question: Can I start without a paid plan?
items.answer: Yes. New organizations start on Free, which supports up to three managed workers.

items.question: Can I buy Team, Business or Scale today?
items.answer: Not yet. The paid plans are in the product catalog, but a billing provider and checkout are not connected.

items.question: Does a larger plan give workers more authority?
items.answer: No. Plan capacity is separate from identity, capability, risk, policy, approvals and incident controls.

closing.headline: Put the first worker to work.
closing.body: Begin on Free and define a clear role, job and supervisor.
